verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, alert case management, SAR-filing support, or a documented split of compliance duties between the user, platform and bank. The only related item is onboarding KYC/KYB verification with manual review, which is an adjacent capability and does not cover the ongoing compliance workload this story asks about.

support.subject: As an ops user, the compliance workload is tooled — transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, case management for alerts, and SAR-filing support with a clear split of duties between me, the platform, and the bank

citations.quote: Bring your own KYC/KYB process, or use our KYC/KYB verifications with support for manual reviewing.
